claim_boundary.claim_if_null: The global Stage 26/27A component path remains valid, but decomposing it into three-head per-class covers did not improve held-out hard-partner readout margins under the preregistered controls.
claim_boundary.claim_if_pass: Within the Stage 26/27A validated Pythia-160M attention-head family, class-local Foundation covers improve held-out hard-partner readout margins over same-size global and random subset controls.
claim_boundary.forbidden_claims: Do not claim exact neurons, complete circuits, raw CAS-symbol understanding, internal CAS compiler behavior, Noetic/40-Element component causality, free-form generation control, or cross-model component generality from Stage 27C.
claim_boundary.scope_boundary: Stage 27C is bounded to Pythia-160M Stage 7 Foundation probe-logit margins inside the already validated six-head component family. It does not test Noetic/40-Element covers, token sonar, exact neurons, or generation control.

formal_anchor: Coverage-family framing: the six selected heads form a local cover for the Foundation readout. Stage 27C asks whether smaller class-indexed subcovers refine that cover for specific Foundation hard-partner distinctions.

gates.criterion: Stage 7 activation artifact hash matches the locked manifest.
gates.name: artifact_contract

gates.criterion: Stage 26 and Stage 27A source reports are PASS and selected components match the top-six attention-head family.
gates.name: component_path_contract

gates.criterion: Class-cover learning rows come only from train split; scoring rows come only from test split.
gates.name: learn_eval_separation

gates.criterion: Per-class covers beat the same-size global-prefix cover on mean target-vs-hard-partner probe-logit margin.
gates.name: same_size_global_control

gates.criterion: Per-class covers beat the same-size global-prefix cover on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: paired_global_sign_test

gates.criterion: Per-class covers beat per-row random-subset mean margin on at least 60% of eval rows with sign-test p<0.05.
gates.name: matched_random_subset_control

gates.criterion: At least 55% of eval rows have positive target-vs-hard-partner margin under the per-class cover.
gates.name: positive_margin_floor

gates.criterion: Report per-class cover margin as a fraction of the full six-head global cover margin; this is diagnostic, not required for PASS.
gates.name: full_global_ceiling

method: Commit this pre-registration before any Stage 27C GPU result is generated.
Refit the locked Stage 7 28-way Foundation probe on the locked layer-6 focus-token artifact.
Verify Stage 26 and Stage 27A are PASS with the same selected six-head component family; Stage 27B is used only as the grey baseline.
Build a balanced cover-learning subset from Stage 7 train rows and a disjoint balanced evaluation subset from Stage 7 test rows.
For each cover-learning row, globally ablate the selected six heads, then patch each selected head individually.
Score each individual head by target-vs-hard-partner Foundation probe-logit margin lift over the globally ablated state.
For each Foundation class, define a three-head class-local cover as the top three selected heads by mean lift on learn rows for that class.
On held-out evaluation rows, compare class-local covers against a same-size global-prefix cover and same-size random subsets of the selected six-head family.
Report full six-head global cover as a ceiling, not as the same-size primary control.
motivation: Stage 26/27A localized and path-patched a global six-head Foundation cover, while Stage 27B showed only partial aggregate token contrast. Stage 27C tests whether hard-partner distinctions live in class-local subcovers inside the validated head family.
